headline: Colombia's Centro Democrático Proposes Pension System Counter-Reform
summary: Colombia's opposition party Centro Democrático submitted a pension counter-reform proposal restoring worker choice between Colpensiones and private funds without age transfer limits.
why: Pension legislation directly impacts Colombia's capital markets and the asset volumes managed by private fund managers.

impacts.name: Colombian Pension Funds
impacts.why: Restoring freedom of movement between public and private managers could protect private fund assets.
